owner_scope: Closed volumetric cosmetic mesh/helper only; CombatGore and profile integration are owned separately.

api.sweep_result: hit:bool,fraction:float,transform:Transform3D; on hit position:Vector3,normal:Vector3,starting_overlap:bool; overlaps also overlap_recovered:bool. transform is conservative safe/recovered pose.
api.support_result: supported:bool,reason:String; if supported transform:Transform3D,contacts:PackedVector3Array,support_polygon:PackedVector2Array. False means continue falling or expire through owning budget, never freeze in air.

geometry.outline: At most ten native alpha row slices, left/right bounds; <=20 outline vertices. Actual generated semi-transparent haze below .5 is excluded. No source resampling or raster writes.
geometry.closed_volume: Three rings: front/back 72% silhouette, full-width middle ring; original concave silhouette caps triangulated with explicit +/-Z normals, sides use ring winding. All triangle edges have two opposite owners, including bent limbs.
geometry.source: Approved existing gore-v2 atlas cells and AtlasTexture native rectangles, with legacy source fallback. No new raster art.
geometry.caps: Native source texture and precise original cell/AtlasTexture region UVs, nearest sampling and half-texel inset; optional existing tint only.
geometry.sides: Opaque native 16x16 interior tissue/armor patch, selected by >=.9 alpha center/corner/midpoint samples; no alpha cutout. Optional coat_tint/exposed_tint applies to sides. Flesh/metal roughness/metallic differ.
geometry.center_of_mass: Exact uniform solid volume integral over oriented closed triangle mesh. Cosmetic parts have uniform density; no simulated rigid body.

physics_and_settlement.registration: MeshInstance3D has no descendants. ConvexPolygonShape3D and SphereShape3D are query resources only and never attach to a CollisionObject3D. Queries do not change world collision or hit ownership.
physics_and_settlement.sweep: A ceil-rounded radius sphere encloses every orientation of the real mesh. cast_motion prevents translation/rotation wall/floor tunnelling conservatively. Starting overlap is independently checked; when Godot reports deep overlap without rest normal, bounded six-axis exterior rays recover a surface normal before advancement.
physics_and_settlement.support: Nearest current tumble face candidates align to downward support; every mesh vertex probes local shared terrain. Maximum-height fit keeps all sampled vertices above floor/tread. >=3 contacts must enclose projected uniform COM; final convex volume overlap query rejects wall/riser penetration.
physics_and_settlement.unsupported: Edges/empty space without stable bearing return false; owner continues flight or expires. No remote-floor snapping.
physics_and_settlement.motion_owner: CombatGore owns actual three-axis angular motion, gravity, bounce, life/budget, pause, reset and persistent remains. Support keeps the SAME closed MeshInstance3D; flat decals remain blood only.

verification.scope: All eight species/93 actual part specs; directed closed topology, positive volume, native cell UV bounds/opaque material, side alpha sample, zero collision descendants, <=196 triangles; real native shared-world floor, stair treads, ledge support, unsupported edges/empty fall, volume floor/thin-wall sweep and deep starting overlap recovery.
limits: Low-poly beveled extrusions reuse existing front-painted anatomy; complete bespoke anatomical sculpting is not claimed.
Existing source haze/art quality is retained within the .5 alpha contour; source pixels are unchanged.
Conservative query sphere may contact earlier than the exact mesh. Settlement uses the real volume and terrain contacts.
Local fit is deliberately conservative at difficult stair/ledge combinations and may reject them so the owner continues falling or expires.
Gallery captures establish bounded component geometry. Actual Main combat, lifecycle and clinical context are independent specialist/root acceptance evidence.
